regions.full_page: Blindness Frank J. Boyle 42, foreman in Dodge Br's Factory 1481 Townsend Ave. Enrolled July 13 in S.M.A. for blindness three days before being sent to Specialist in Niles Mich. One Specialist declared "Absolutely hopeless" never to see again. Before leaving for 2nd Specialis he sees his Mother as in tears they kiss Good Bye. Now able to read the newspaper. Thanks be to God! P.S. While testing his eyes at Niles and before treated at all they phone his Mother: "Don't worry Mother, Frank can see."
